messages:
maria: Heads-up — seeing recurring 99th/99.9th latency spikes from multi-tenant GPU racks in eu-west since 04:30 UTC. Patterns point to priority inversion when dedicated burst requests land into shared queues.
sam: Any coro logs / queue dumps? link?
maria: quick paste:
```
queue_stats: {shared_q=12, dedicated_burst=3, burst_pad_len=512, inflight_small=82, inflight_large=6}
latency_tail: 99.9=1.2s 99=0.45s
```
sam: hmm. burst_pad is expanding and hogging headroom. Are we routing burst requests to fractional-shelves? Could we prefer dedicated slices first?
ryan: this smells like queue-priority inversion + kvcache regen pressure. Large-model prefill pushes conduit, small low-qps but bursty tenants get queued behind.
jin: which models/sequence lengths? Could be long-prefill with multistep attention.
maria: mostly rlm-13b-quant and 8k seq runs from 'adopt' tenants.
alloc-bot: [alloc-event] 1739998200: tenant 'adopt-prod' allocated fractional-shelf id=fs-23 burst_mode=on
sam: mitigation idea: introduce 'burst_pad' lane with strict token-bucket shaping and priority ceiling for dedicated pools only. Also reduce shard weight for fractional for 10m canary.
ryan: FYI cost impact if we reserve lanes for burst: +4% GPU idle; but reduces 99.9 by ~700ms per sample — probably worth it for latency SLO customers.
maria: can we roll a tiny config change? example:
```
PATCH /infra/v1/routing
{"region":"eu-west","policy":{"fractional_weight":0.6,"burst_pad_shaping":{"rate":2000,"burst_max":10}}}
```
sam: ok I'll push a canary to eu-west rack-12 at 05:15 UTC, monitor 5m windows. ryan pls watch SLO dashboards and cost signal.
ryan: watching. setting alert: slo.euw.99.9 > 1s for 3m
jin: also recommend kvcache pre-warm for rlm-13b during peak canary to reduce regen pressure.
maria: noted. if canary looks good we'll expand to two racks. thanks :thumbsup:
sam: +1
alloc-bot: [deploy] routing policy canary -> eu-west/rack-12 started 1739999700
maria: keeping thread here; will post results in ~30m.
